evidence_class: Static implementation intent before native-harness source edits; no Cargo, numerical, physical, or target execution.
deliverable: One feature-gated hidden facade that runs the existing M1PhysicalTrustRegionAdapter through the existing FoundationState controller body from an immutable M1CoupledColumnInput and canonical 21-coordinate seed already captured by M1DiagnosticObservation.
required_seams: RealM1ProviderCaller::prepare_fixed_sequence_support arms the existing diagnostic observation before baseline policy and consumes its complete input plus seed only after that arm returns.

The facade constructs M1PhysicalTrustRegionAdapter::new(input.clone(), M1CoupledColumnTrial::from_coordinates(seed)) and calls the existing controller-run/finalization body; it does not reconstruct input, seed, JSON, or a solver body.
The compact observation carries actual typed outcome and existing controller/budget accounting, while adapter and controller types remain crate-private.
feature_policy: m1-trust-region-native-harness is default-off and may include test-support, but never m1-trust-region-physical-stage; cfg expansion is restricted to body types, controller/interface, Stage1 certificate, adapter/provenance, and budget needed by this facade.
exclusions: No production/default dispatch, public normal API, dependency, numerical method, seed substitution, fixture/JSON reconstruction, target execution, or physical execution.
Existing m1_coupled_tests fixtures, poison controls, analytic controls, and physical-stage selector closure remain under their current cfg(test) gates.
selected_followup_check_owned_by_orchest: cargo check for the exact LSE and orchestrator native-harness feature closure, followed only by the owner-selected source-quality and integration selectors; this writer runs no Cargo command.
